fields.description: Two-character company code used in visit numbers: YY + Company ID + 6-digit running number.
fields.label: Company ID

fields.description: Block check-in and check-out when the browser location is not available.
fields.label: Require Location for Check In / Check Out

fields.description: A check-in farther than this from the customer's location is saved with a warning. 0 switches the comparison off.
fields.label: Geofence Radius (m)

fields.description: Used to look up the customer's address coordinates at check-in. Leave empty to skip the lookup.
fields.label: Google Maps API Key

fields.description: Every Monday at 9:00 email last week's visit report: every employee gets their own visits, managers get their team. Leave off on test sites.
fields.label: Send Weekly Report

fields.description: Email addresses that get the report of all employees, separated by commas. Leave empty to send it to every administrator.
fields.label: Send All Employees Report To
